Class.name: IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Util.Crypto.EnsRequest
Class.Description: Base class for HealthShare Ensemble Requests

Parameter.name: XMLIGNOREINVALIDTAG
Parameter.Description: If XMLIGNOREINVALIDTAG is set = 1, then unexpected elements will be ignored. We use this to allow our web services to be extensible and to work across version boundaries. With this set to one, we can, for instance, update the hub/registry to a new version, where some of the xml messages have new properties, and have that communicate with a gateway running a previous version, where the properties aren't there.

Parameter.name: XMLIGNORENULL
Parameter.Description: If XMLIGNORENULL is set = "inputonly", then both missing tags in the XML and empty strings are input as "". Output of "" and $c(0) are for XMLIGNORENULL = 0: $c(0) is output as an empty tag (i.e. <tag></tag>) and "" is output as no tag.

Property.name: HSMinVersion
Property.Description: Can be set by a new service to allow the web client to not attempt to invoke a service that doesn't exist on a gateway running an older version
